text: …if he dwells in the emptiness of the internal, he engages in bringing about the emptiness of the internal; he does not engage in the perfection of wisdom. Blessed One, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva, when practising the perfection of wisdom, lacking skill in means, with a mind dwelling in making 'I' and making 'mine', dwells in the emptiness of the external, he engages in bringing about the emptiness of the external; he does not engage in the perfection of wisdom. Blessed…
